items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: The interviewee discusses a third party's relationship with Danny Barber ('he and Danny Barber got started together... Danny introduced him to him') but does not describe a personal relationship with Danny Barber himself.

ctx.x: From downtown. From downtown. I think he and Danny Barber got started together. I think Danny introduced him to him. Yeah. But he seems a little, you know, like he'd be delicate, you know, he's not a strong man.

No, well he mostly stuck to the music, you see. He couldn't memorize or nothing like that. You see, and everything that he wanted to play, he had to have the music for it, you see. He couldn't memorize it.
